items.exampleEn: How much do you reckon this old bike is worth?
items.exampleZh: 你覺得這台舊腳踏車值多少錢？

items.exampleEn: He often muses about moving to the countryside.
items.exampleZh: 他常常想著要搬到鄉下去。

items.exampleEn: The whole team was discredited by one player's mistake.
items.exampleZh: 一名球員的錯誤讓整個團隊失去了信用。

items.exampleEn: I'm doubtful about his plan to open a restaurant.
items.exampleZh: 我對他開餐廳的計畫存疑。

items.exampleEn: He showed a total disregard for the rules.
She willingly gave up her seat to a mother with a baby.
items.exampleZh: 她心甘情願把座位讓給一位抱著嬰兒的媽媽。

items.exampleEn: A common misconception is that adults cannot learn a new language.
items.exampleZh: 一個常見的誤解是成年人學不會新語言。

items.exampleEn: The waiter was very attentive and filled our glasses again and again.
items.exampleZh: 那位服務生很周到，一次又一次幫我們把杯子加滿。

items.sentenceEn: Throwing trash on the beach shows a disregard for nature.
items.sentenceZh: 在海灘上亂丟垃圾，表示不尊重大自然。

items.audioEn: I reckon the new cafe will be busy, because the coffee there is cheap.
items.audioZh: 我認為那家新咖啡店會很忙，因為那裡的咖啡很便宜。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼覺得那家新咖啡店會很忙？
options: The coffee there tastes very good
The cafe is new and very big
The new cafe has lots of seats

items.sentenceEn: Good listeners are attentive and don't look at their phones.
items.sentenceZh: 好的聽眾很專心，不會一直看手機。

items.sentenceEn: There's a misconception that cheap food is always bad.
items.sentenceZh: 有一種誤解，認為便宜的食物一定不好。

items.stemEn: I'm ____ that we'll finish on time; there's still so much to do.
items.stemZh: 我很懷疑我們能準時完成，還有好多事要做。

items.stemEn: Someone spread lies online to ____ the small bakery.
items.stemZh: 有人在網路上散播謊言，想抹黑那家小麵包店。

items.passageEn: Many people believe that pet fish can only remember things for three seconds, but this is a common misconception. The owner of our local pet shop, who is very attentive to his fish, reckons they can remember things for months. He has trained his fish to swim to one corner when he rings a small bell, which is a novelty for most visitors. Some scientists have also done tests that discredit the old idea. My little sister was doubtful at first, but after watching the fish for ten minutes, she willingly changed her mind. Now she sits by the tank and muses about what else they might remember.
items.passageZh: 很多人以為寵物魚只能記住三秒鐘的事，但這是一個常見的誤解。我們附近寵物店的老闆非常用心照顧他的魚，他認為魚可以記住好幾個月的事。他訓練他的魚，只要他搖一個小鈴，魚就會游到某個角落，這對大部分客人來說都很新奇。有些科學家做的測試也推翻了這個舊說法。我妹妹一開始不太相信，但看了十分鐘的魚之後，她心甘情願地改變了想法。現在她會坐在魚缸旁邊，想著那些魚還可能記得什麼。

questions.questionZh: 店老闆怎麼訓練他的魚？
options: 每天固定時間在水裡放一顆紅球
搖小鈴讓牠們游到角落
看了十分鐘就覺得無聊

items.promptZh: 他心甘情願地在星期六留下來加班。
referenceEn: He willingly stayed late at work on Saturday.
On Saturday, he willingly stayed at work after hours.
rubricZh: willingly 的用法，例如 willingly stayed 等
「留下來加班」可寫，例如 stayed late at work、stayed at work after hours 等

items.promptZh: 我爸爸估計這台舊冰箱還能再用五年。
referenceEn: My dad reckons this old fridge will last another five years.
My father reckons that the old fridge can work for five more years.
rubricZh: reckon 表示「估計、認為」，動詞配合主詞（例如 reckons、reckoned 等）
「還能再用五年」可寫，例如 will last another five years、can work for five more years 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：muse 釋義「沉思；冥想」：台灣「冥想」通指 meditate（靜坐冥想），與 muse（默想、反覆思索）不同，建議改「沉思；默想；反覆思索」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：見本檔 resolvedAfterFinalReview 同題修正紀錄。
